Immerse yourself in the electrifying beats of "Jaada" from "Aavesham", Starring Fahadh Faasil & Others, Sung by Sreenath Bhasi, Lyrics Written by Vinayak Sasikumar, Music Composed by Sushin Shyam. Written and Directed by Jithu Madhavan. Produced by Nazriya Nazim & Anwar Rasheed. Watch now and get lost in the magic of "Jaada"
In Cinemas from April 11,2024.
